neighbours.label: Opening parenthesis right after a capitalised multi-word technical or institutional name, where an acronym of that name is expected next (Instrument Landing System ⟦(⟧ILS)
fire: The drone carries a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor to map the terrain.
Adults with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) were enrolled in the trial.
The project was funded by the European Research Council (ERC) from 2019.
Samples were analysed by High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) in our lab.
Every vessel must carry an Automatic Identification System (AIS) transponder.
Staff were trained by the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) last spring.
Cognition was scored with the Mini Mental State Examination (MMSE) at baseline.
The plant uses a Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) to control each pump.
quiet: The drone carries a small laser sensor (bought last year) to map the terrain.
Adults with long-term lung problems (mostly older men) were enrolled in the trial.
The project was funded by a private donor (who asked not to be named) from 2019.
Samples were analysed twice (once in March and once in May) in our lab.
Every vessel must carry a working radio (and a spare one) at all times.
Staff were trained by local volunteers (all of them nurses) last spring.
Cognition was scored by two raters (working separately) at baseline.
The plant uses two old pumps (installed in 1974) to move the water.
